Fes, Morocco, 1920s, historically accurate. ABSOLUTELY NO PEOPLE, no animals, no text. Scene:
chambre_jour: interior of the single upstairs room where a modest family lives, in daytime: long narrow room with thick lime-washed walls, a tall carved wooden double door open onto a gallery, a small window with a flowered red curtain letting in warm sunlight, thin mattresses with striped covers and cushions along the walls on the floor, a worn rug, a low round wooden table in the middle with a tea tray, a copper kettle on a small clay brazier with glowing charcoal in a corner, a wooden chest, shelves with copper pots, plates and a mirror, a niche in the wall. Warm cosy light, dust in a sunbeam. Eye-level view from one end of the room, empty open floor space in the foreground centre for characters.
terrasse: a flat rooftop terrace of an old Fes house in bright morning sun: low whitewashed parapet walls, many aromatic plants (mint, verbena, sage, absinthe) growing in chipped clay pots and old dented enamel cooking pots, a laundry line, a little wooden door of the stair hut, beyond the parapet the sea of flat roofs, terraces, a green-tiled minaret and the hills of Fes under a clear blue sky with small white clouds. Empty open floor in the foreground centre.
rue_foule: a busy narrow covered street of the Fes medina at midday, empty of people but full of life's traces: tall old walls, small open shop stalls on both sides with piles of goods (babouches, fabrics, copper, spices in sacks), reed trellis overhead casting striped sunlight and shadow on the beaten earth ground, a stone step, an archway in the distance, hanging lanterns. Eye-level, deep perspective, wide open street floor in the centre for a crowd to be added.
cimetiere: the cemetery outside the shrine of Sidi Ali Boughaleb in Fes, afternoon sun: many small whitewashed tombs covered with orange and red marigold flowers glowing in the sun, a little dusty square with a few empty market stalls (pyramids of oranges, clay braziers, bundles of firewood), and behind them the white mausoleum with a steep green-glazed tiled roof and a small green dome, a tall palm tree, a tender blue sky with capricious white and pink clouds. Warm, joyful, luminous.
sucreries: close-up of a sweets vendor's stall table in a Fes market in sunshine: rows of shiny handmade sugar candies shaped like yellow roosters and little chicks decorated with pink sugar threads, small transparent sugar teapots, tiny sugar babouches and little bellows, arranged on a wooden tray with a white cloth, a few candy sticks in a jar, blurred sunny market background. Magical, glowing like treasure, jewel colours.
zaouia_cour: the courtyard of a Moroccan saint's shrine (zaouia) in Fes: a large square courtyard open to the sky with a simple zellige floor, whitewashed arcades with horseshoe arches all around, in the centre four big glazed terracotta water jars on a low stone platform with a copper cup, green-tiled roof edges, a doorway at the back leading to a dim room where candles glow, soft afternoon sunlight and cool shadows, a few pigeons feathers on the floor. Peaceful, sacred. Wide open floor in the foreground.
catafalque: interior of the saint's tomb room of a Moroccan shrine in Fes: a square room with a carved and painted wooden dome ceiling, in the centre a large wooden catafalque (tomb box) covered with a green embroidered silk cloth with golden Arabic-style decorative bands (no readable letters), surrounded by a carved wooden grille, many candles and oil lamps glowing, hanging brass lanterns, rugs on the floor, two small doors on each side leading to pilgrims' rooms, warm golden candlelight and incense smoke in the air. Reverent, mysterious. Empty floor space in front of the catafalque.
patio_matin: the central patio of an old three-storey Fes house (Dar Chouafa) at early dawn, blue half-light turning golden at the top: zellige floor, a small tiled fountain against one wall and a stone well with a wooden cover and a bucket, dark doorways, wooden galleries with carved balustrades on the upper floors, the top of the patio wall edge against a pale sky (a good place for birds to perch), cool shadows lingering in the corners. Empty patio floor in the centre.
escalier: a steep narrow stone staircase inside an old Fes house: worn uneven steps turning upward, thick whitewashed walls with a painted dado of faded ochre and green, a small arched window high above letting in a shaft of warm light from the terrace, a wooden handrail, deep cool shadows below. Vertical feel but in a 16:9 frame, eye level from the middle of the stairs.
chambre_fatma: the poor but warm room of a gardener's wife in the same Fes house: a humble room with a mat on the floor, a big wooden couscous-rolling platter (gsaa) with semolina, a pile of fresh vegetables in the corner (turnips, carrots, a big red pumpkin slice, onions, long red radishes in a basket), a clay brazier, a few clay pots, a simple curtain in the doorway, morning sunlight through the open door. Empty floor space in the foreground.
